Formats:
 D.. = Demuxing supported
 .E. = Muxing supported
 ..d = Is a device
 ---
 D d alsa            ALSA audio input
 D   iamf            Raw Immersive Audio Model and Formats
 D   matroska,webm   Matroska / WebM
 D   mov,mp4,m4a,3gp,3g2,mj2 QuickTime / MOV
 D   mpegts          MPEG-TS (MPEG-2 Transport Stream)
